description: This file implements the Nordic Semiconductor NRF clock calibration logic, including temperature-based calibration, clock request/release management, and calibration cycle control.

methods.name: cal_hf_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when HF clock request completes, triggers temperature measurement or calibration start.

methods.name: cal_lf_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when LF clock request completes, triggers HF clock request.

methods.name: start_hw_cal
methods.description: Starts hardware clock calibration assuming HFCLK XTAL is on.

methods.name: start_cycle
methods.description: Starts a new calibration cycle by setting timer and releasing clocks.

methods.name: start_cal_process
methods.description: Initiates the calibration process, requesting necessary clocks.

methods.name: timeout_handler
methods.description: Handles timer timeout to start calibration cycle.

methods.name: measure_temperature
methods.description: Reads temperature sensor and determines if calibration should start based on temperature change.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_force_start
methods.description: Forces start of calibration if not already in progress.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_lfclk_started
methods.description: Handles event when LF clock starts, triggers calibration cycle.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_lfclk_stopped
methods.description: Handles event when LF clock stops, stops calibration timer.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_done_handler
methods.description: Handles completion of calibration, updates counters, and starts new cycle.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_count
methods.description: Returns total calibration count if debug enabled.

methods.name: z_nrf_clock_calibration_skips_count
methods.description: Returns total skipped calibrations if debug enabled.
